α : Type u_1
β : Type u_2
inst✝ : BEq α
a : α
l : AssocList α β
⊢ (match l with
    | nil => none
    | cons k v es =>
      match k == a with
      | true => some v
      | false => find? a es) =
    match
      List.find? (fun x => x.fst == a)
        (match l with
        | nil => []
        | cons a b es => (a, b) :: toList es) with
    | some x => some x.snd
    | none => none
